e.title_en: Vortex ActuaryOS: a 1.3 KB README sitting beside a 106 KB implementation plan and a 44 KB multi-agent specification
e.title_hk: Vortex ActuaryOS：README 只 1.3 KB，倉庫裡卻躺著一份 106 KB 的實施計劃與 44 KB 的多智能體規格
e.summary: 一个面向「月度组合复核」的人在环多智能体系统：前端为 Next.js 仪表板、后端为 FastAPI 编排器与智能体，并把「确定性分析」与智能体分开；README 仅 1,289 字节，但仓库内另有一份 105,971 字节的实施计划（自述为构建顺序的唯一依据）与一份 44,363 字节的多智能体系统规格，并单列一节「已锁定的决定」写明 LLM 接入方式、身份 seam、测试用隔离 schema 与计价币种
e.summary_hk: 一個面向「月度組合複核」的人在環多智能體系統：前端為 Next.js 儀表板、後端為 FastAPI 編排器與智能體，並把「確定性分析」與智能體分開；README 僅 1,289 位元組，但倉庫內另有一份 105,971 位元組的實施計劃（自述為構建順序的唯一依據）與一份 44,363 位元組的多智能體系統規格，並單列一節「已鎖定的決定」寫明 LLM 接入方式、身份 seam、測試用隔離 schema 與計價幣種
e.summary_en: A human-in-the-loop multi-agent system for the monthly portfolio review: a Next.js dashboard, a FastAPI orchestrator with agents, and deterministic analytics kept separate from the agents; the README is only 1,289 bytes, but the repository also carries a 105,971-byte implementation plan (described as the source of truth for build order) and a 44,363-byte multi-agent system specification, plus a "Decisions (locked)" section stating the LLM wiring, an identity seam, an isolated schema for tests and the reporting currency
e.body:
**actuary-os**（自述名 **Vortex ActuaryOS**）是一个**面向「月度组合复核」的人在环多智能体系统**（仓库 `Parv-005/actuary-os`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 531 KB、创建于 2026-09-06、最后推送 2026-09-07**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404）**、**无 topics**；**README 实测仅 1,289 字节**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把假设写成可核对的东西」**中的**第四种，也是文档形态最反常的一种：薄的是 README，厚的是仓库里的规格与计划**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库根目录实测**）：**README 标题逐字为「Vortex ActuaryOS」**，**首句逐字为**：**「**Human-in-the-loop multi-agent system for the Monthly Portfolio Review.**」**；**并逐字指引**：**「See `Vortex_ActuaryOS_Implementation_Plan.md` (**source of truth for build order**) and `Vortex_ActuaryOS_Multi_Agent_System_Specification.md` (**product spec**).」**。⭐⭐⭐ **根目录实测，是本条目最值得记的一处**：**`README.md` 仅 **1,289 字节**，而同一目录下另有 **`Vortex_ActuaryOS_Implementation_Plan.md`（**105,971 字节**）与 `Vortex_ActuaryOS_Multi_Agent_System_Specification.md`（**44,363 字节**）****——**即 README 与详细文档的体量比约为 **1 : 116****。**其余根目录实测**：**`.env.example`（1,316 字节）、`.github`、`.gitignore`、`Makefile`（568 字节）、`backend/`、`docs/`、`frontend/`、`sample_data/`、`scripts/`**。**README 的 Quickstart 逐字实测**：**`make setup`（venv ＋ npm install）**；**`cp .env.example backend/.env`（填 `DATABASE_URL`、`SUPABASE_*`、`LLM_*`）**；**`make migrate`（**幂等 SQL 迁移，遵循 `APP_DB_SCHEMA`**）**；**`make seed`（样例数据 ＋ 8 月工作流 ＋ 演示文件 → Storage）**；**`make dev`（uvicorn :8000，`/docs`）**；**另起终端 `cd frontend && npm run dev`（:3000）**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「README 薄、规格厚」这一形态是本条目最有价值的一点，也正好是本会话既有观察的**反面****——**本站此前已 5 次记录「元数据稀疏但 README 详实」（第 325／326／327 轮各一次、第 328 轮两次）**，**而本条是**反过来**：**README 只有 1,289 字节，把「构建顺序的唯一依据」与「产品规格」分别放在两份共 **150,334 字节**的仓库内文档里****。⭐⭐ **对做交付的学生，这提示一种**把完整性与入口分开**的组织方式**：**README 只做入口与快速上手，**深度内容不塞进入口文档****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**这种做法在本例中效果良好**——**README 短到无法据此判断系统的实际完成度**，**而两份大文档本次均未读**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「与智能体分开的**确定性分析**」是本条目在架构上最值得记的一点**——**README 的目录说明逐字为**：**「`backend/` — FastAPI + orchestrator + agents + **deterministic analytics**」**——**即在同一个后端里，**确定性分析**与**智能体**被并列列出而不是混为一谈**。⭐⭐ **这与本站反复出现的同一条判断同源**：**让模型去找输入、让确定性代码做算术**（**第 329 轮 [[insurance-tabular-review]] 的三种列型 —— `extract`／`analysis`／**`calculate` 由应用程序计算**；同轮 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的**正则优先、LLM 兜底**加**非 LLM 的 grounding 回查****）；**本条是这一取舍在**多智能体系统**里的落点**（**⚠️ 本次未读其 `backend/` 源码，**不主张**该分离在实现中确实成立**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「已锁定的决定（Decisions (locked)）」一节逐字实测，是本轮主题最直接的形态**——**本节把四条决定写成不可再商量的形式**：**① LLM：使用 **OpenAI 兼容端点**（`LLM_BASE_URL`／`API_KEY`／`MODEL`），**并设 `LLM_PROVIDER=fake` 供 CI／测试使用****；**② 身份：公开演示，**内置一个种子化的「Demo Actuary」（`get_current_actor()` seam）****；**③ 数据库：**dev 与 prod 共用 Supabase 项目**，**测试用隔离的 `test` schema**；**④ 计价币种：**INR（Rs.）****。⭐⭐⭐ **其中两点值得单独记**：**`LLM_PROVIDER=fake` 让 CI 与测试**不依赖真实模型调用****（**与第 329 轮 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的「3 个 LLM 用例缺 API key 时报 skipped 而非 failing」属同一类**无密钥可测**安排**）；**而 `get_current_actor()` 被显式称为一个 **seam（接缝）****——**即身份读取被收在一处，便于替换为真实鉴权**（**可与第 329 轮 [[claim-to-confidence]] 的「权限矩阵由后端强制 ＋ 一条智能体身份被拒的负向测试」并读**——**两者都在处理**谁有权让数字入账**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该 seam 已接入任何真实身份体系**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **`Makefile`（568 字节）逐字实测，与 README 一致且多出几个目标**：**`setup`／`migrate`／`seed`／**`reset-demo`**／`dev`／`test`／`lint`／`backend-test`／`frontend-test`**；其中**`backend-test` 逐字为 `cd backend && APP_DB_SCHEMA=test .venv/bin/pytest -q`**（**即测试确实跑在隔离的 `test` schema 上**，**与「已锁定的决定」第 ③ 条对应**）、**`lint` 逐字为 `ruff check app scripts tests`**、**`seed` 逐字先跑 `generate_sample_data.py` 再跑 `seed.py`**。⭐⭐ **`reset-demo` 这个目标值得单独注意**：**它意味着**演示状态可以被重置****——**对要反复演示同一套数据的场景，这是一个务实的安排**（**⚠️ 本次未运行任何目标**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **样例数据用固定随机种子生成**——**`sample_data/` 逐字说明为「generated CSVs (**RNG seed 42**) + SCENARIOS.md」**；**与同批 [[catrisk-sim]] 的「默认使用固定随机种子」属同一做法**。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **前端为 Next.js 14 仪表板且用 **REST 轮询、间隔 2 秒****——**逐字为「Next.js 14 dashboard (REST polling, 2s)」**；**即它没有采用流式推送**，**而选了**固定间隔轮询****（**对**多智能体长流程的进度呈现**，这是一个简单但会带来延迟与请求量的选择**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该选择恰当**）。**⑦ ⭐ **`docs/` 逐字含 architecture、api、runbook、demo-script 四类**——**即除规格与计划外，还准备了**运行手册与演示脚本****。**⑧ ⭐ **计价币种为 INR，且样例含「8 月工作流」**——**暗示其场景设定在印度、且以**月度**为周期**（**与「月度组合复核」一致**）。**⑨ ⭐ 可与本站与智能体化精算工作流相关的条目并读**：[[claim-to-confidence]]（**第 329 轮：一笔修正穿过四个职能，含权限矩阵与负向测试**）、[[reinsurance-treaty-agent]]、[[insurance-tabular-review]]、[[underwriting-decision-safety]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[hx-actuarial-agent-prompts]]、[[actuarial-python-lab]]、[[valact-rag]]、[[agentic-bop-underwriting]]、[[underwriting-copilot]]、[[insurance-multi-agent-langgraph]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 该仓库实测**无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404）****——**本词条明确记录，并提示使用、部署或再分发其代码前必须自行确认授权状况**；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、仓库根目录清单、README（1,289 字节）全文、`Makefile`（568 字节）全文**，⭐⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装、未运行任何 `make` 目标、未启动其后端或前端、未读 `Vortex_ActuaryOS_Implementation_Plan.md`（105,971 字节）与 `Vortex_ActuaryOS_Multi_Agent_System_Specification.md`（44,363 字节）**任何内容**、未读 `backend/`／`frontend/`／`scripts/`／`docs/` 下任何文件、未读 `.env.example`、未查看 `sample_data/`****，因此**不能转述其智能体划分、编排逻辑、月度复核的具体步骤、确定性分析的范围、数据模型、API 形状或任何提示词**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **未读到那份 105,971 字节的实施计划与 44,363 字节的规格的任何一行****——**而 README 明确把它们分别称为「构建顺序的唯一依据」与「产品规格」**；**因此**本词条对该系统实际做什么的描述**仅限于 README 与 `Makefile` 所载****；**这是本条目最需要后续补读的一处**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**「deterministic analytics」与 agents 在实现中是否真的分离**——**本词条只核实到它被写进 README 的目录说明**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实**「已锁定的决定」四条在实现中是否确实被遵守**（**例如 `LLM_PROVIDER=fake` 是否真的能在无真实模型下跑通测试、`APP_DB_SCHEMA=test` 是否确实隔离**）；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其「月度组合复核」流程是否符合任何真实的精算或保险公司流程**——**README 未说明其方法论依据**；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其种子化的「Demo Actuary」身份 seam 与公开演示的鉴权安排是否恰当**——**「公开演示 ＋ 种子身份」在真实部署中通常需要额外控制**；**本词条**不主张**其身份设计适合生产**；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其样例数据与场景（含「8 月工作流」、INR 计价）是否代表任何真实组合**；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ 涉及**组合复核与可能的人员／客户数据****——**未评估其在数据保护方面的安排**；**⑩ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、创建于 2026-09-06、推送于 2026-09-07**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑪ ⭐ README 仅 1,289 字节，无 topics、无仓库描述之外的元数据**——**其可评估性因此显著低于同类项目**（**此为本词条的判断**）；**⑫ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 实测为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Parv-005/actuary-os`、`/readme` 与 `/contents/` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 1,289 字节与 `Makefile` 568 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对；两份大文档的体量以根目录清单实测值为准，**内容未读**）；**未克隆、未安装、未运行任何 make 目标、未启动前后端、未读任何源码与文档正文**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「README 薄、規格厚」是本條目最有價值的一點，也正好是本會話既有觀察的**反面****——**本站此前已 5 次記錄「元數據稀疏但 README 詳實」，而本條是**反過來****：**README 只 1,289 位元組，把「構建順序的唯一依據」與「產品規格」放在兩份共 **150,334 位元組**的倉庫內文檔裡****。⭐⭐ **actuary-os** (self-described as **Vortex ActuaryOS**) is **a human-in-the-loop multi-agent system for the monthly portfolio review** (repository `Parv-005/actuary-os`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 531 KB repository, created 2026-09-06 and last pushed 2026-09-07** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`LICENSE` returned 404 on main)** and **no topics**; **the README measures only 1,289 bytes**. It is the fourth of this round’s four takes on **writing assumptions into something a reader can check**, **and its documentation shape is the most unusual: the README is thin and the specifications inside the repository are thick**.

Verifiable details (**all measured from the README and the repository root**): **the README title reads verbatim "Vortex ActuaryOS"**, **its first line reading verbatim "Human-in-the-loop multi-agent system for the Monthly Portfolio Review."**; **and it points verbatim**: **"See `Vortex_ActuaryOS_Implementation_Plan.md` (source of truth for build order) and `Vortex_ActuaryOS_Multi_Agent_System_Specification.md` (product spec)."** ⭐⭐⭐ **The root listing is the entry’s most notable finding**: **`README.md` at 1,289 bytes sits beside `Vortex_ActuaryOS_Implementation_Plan.md` at 105,971 bytes and `Vortex_ActuaryOS_Multi_Agent_System_Specification.md` at 44,363 bytes** — **a README-to-documentation size ratio of roughly 1 : 116**. **The rest of the root measurably contains**: **`.env.example` (1,316 bytes), `.github`, `.gitignore`, `Makefile` (568 bytes), `backend/`, `docs/`, `frontend/`, `sample_data/` and `scripts/`**. **The README’s quickstart reads verbatim**: **`make setup` (venv plus npm install)**; **`cp .env.example backend/.env` (filling `DATABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_*` and `LLM_*`)**; **`make migrate` (idempotent SQL migrations that respect `APP_DB_SCHEMA`)**; **`make seed` (sample data plus an August workflow plus demo files into Storage)**; **`make dev` (uvicorn on :8000, `/docs`)**; **and in a second terminal `cd frontend && npm run dev` (:3000)**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ A thin README with thick specifications is this entry’s most valuable point, and it is the mirror image of an observation already logged here** — **this site has recorded "sparse metadata but detailed README" five times (rounds 325, 326 and 327 once each, round 328 twice)**, **whereas this is the reverse: a 1,289-byte README puts the "source of truth for build order" and the "product spec" into two in-repository documents totalling 150,334 bytes**. ⭐⭐ **For students delivering work it suggests an organisation that separates completeness from the entry point** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the approach works well in this case — the README is too short to judge the system’s actual completeness, and neither large document was read**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ Deterministic analytics kept separate from the agents is the entry’s most notable architectural point** — **the layout description reads verbatim "`backend/` — FastAPI + orchestrator + agents + deterministic analytics"**, **listing deterministic analytics alongside agents rather than conflating them**. ⭐⭐ **This is the same judgement that recurs across this site**: **let the model find the inputs and let deterministic code do the arithmetic** (**the three column kinds in round 329’s [[insurance-tabular-review]], and regex-first with a non-LLM grounding pass in that round’s [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]]**); **here the trade-off lands inside a multi-agent system** (**⚠️ its `backend/` source was not read, so the entry does not claim the separation genuinely holds in the implementation**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ A "Decisions (locked)" section, read verbatim, is the most direct form of this round’s theme** — **it states four decisions as no longer negotiable**: **① LLM: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (`LLM_BASE_URL`, `API_KEY`, `MODEL`), with `LLM_PROVIDER=fake` for CI and tests**; **② Auth: a public demo with a seeded "Demo Actuary" (a `get_current_actor()` seam)**; **③ DB: a shared Supabase project for dev and prod, with an isolated `test` schema for tests**; **④ Currency: INR (Rs.)**. ⭐⭐⭐ **Two of these deserve separate note**: **`LLM_PROVIDER=fake` keeps CI and tests from depending on real model calls** (**the same family as round 329’s [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]], where three LLM cases report as skipped rather than failing without an API key**); **and `get_current_actor()` is explicitly called a seam — identity reading collected in one place so it can be swapped for real authentication** (**readable with round 329’s [[claim-to-confidence]], whose authority matrix is enforced by the back end with a negative test in which an agent identity is denied — both address who is allowed to post numbers**; **⚠️ the entry does not claim the seam is wired to any real identity system**). **④ ⭐⭐ The `Makefile` (568 bytes), read verbatim, matches the README and adds several targets**: **`setup`, `migrate`, `seed`, `reset-demo`, `dev`, `test`, `lint`, `backend-test`, `frontend-test`**; **`backend-test` reads verbatim `cd backend && APP_DB_SCHEMA=test .venv/bin/pytest -q`** (**so tests really do run against the isolated `test` schema, matching locked decision ③**), **`lint` reads verbatim `ruff check app scripts tests`**, **and `seed` runs `generate_sample_data.py` before `seed.py`**. ⭐⭐ **The `reset-demo` target deserves separate note: it means the demo state can be reset**, **a practical arrangement when the same data must be demonstrated repeatedly** (**⚠️ no target was run**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ Sample data is generated from a fixed random seed** — **`sample_data/` reads verbatim as "generated CSVs (RNG seed 42) + SCENARIOS.md"**, **the same practice as this round’s [[catrisk-sim]] and its fixed default seed**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ The front end is a Next.js 14 dashboard using REST polling at a 2-second interval** — **verbatim "Next.js 14 dashboard (REST polling, 2s)"**; **it chose fixed-interval polling rather than streaming** (**for showing progress through a long multi-agent process that is a simple choice, but one carrying latency and request volume; ⚠️ the entry does not claim it is the right one**). **⑦ ⭐ `docs/` measurably contains architecture, api, runbook and demo-script material** — **so beyond the plan and the spec there is a runbook and a demo script**. **⑧ ⭐ Pricing in INR and a sample "August workflow"** **suggest an Indian setting on a monthly cycle**, **consistent with a monthly portfolio review**. **⑨ ⭐ Readable with the site’s agentic actuarial workflow entries**: [[claim-to-confidence]] (**round 329’s entry, tracing one correction across four functions with an authority matrix and a negative test**), [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]], [[insurance-tabular-review]], [[underwriting-decision-safety]], [[insurance-governance]], [[hx-actuarial-agent-prompts]], [[actuarial-python-lab]], [[valact-rag]], [[agentic-bop-underwriting]], [[underwriting-copilot]] and [[insurance-multi-agent-langgraph]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ The repository measurably has no licence file (`LICENSE` returned 404 on main)** — **recorded explicitly, with the advice to confirm authorisation before use, deployment or redistribution**; **②** this check verified **the repository metadata, the root listing, the full 1,289-byte README and the full 568-byte `Makefile`**, ⭐⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install, run any `make` target, start its back end or front end, read any part of the 105,971-byte implementation plan or the 44,363-byte specification, read any file under `backend/`, `frontend/`, `scripts/` or `docs/`, read `.env.example`, or inspect `sample_data/`**, so **its agent decomposition, orchestration logic, the concrete steps of a monthly review, the scope of its deterministic analytics, its data model, its API shape and any prompt content cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Not one line of the 105,971-byte implementation plan or the 44,363-byte specification was read** — **yet the README calls them the source of truth for build order and the product spec respectively** — **so this entry’s description of what the system actually does is limited to what the README and `Makefile` state**; **this is the single most important gap to close for this entry**; **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Whether deterministic analytics and agents are genuinely separated in the implementation was not verified** — **only that it is written into the README’s layout description**; **⑤ ⭐⭐ Whether the four locked decisions are actually honoured was not verified** (**for instance whether `LLM_PROVIDER=fake` really lets the tests run with no real model, and whether `APP_DB_SCHEMA=test` really isolates**); **⑥ ⭐⭐ Whether its monthly portfolio review matches any real actuarial or insurer process was not verified** — **the README states no methodological basis**; **⑦ ⭐⭐ Whether its seeded Demo Actuary identity seam and public-demo authentication are appropriate was not verified** — **"public demo plus seeded identity" normally needs additional controls in a real deployment**; **the entry does not claim its identity design is production-suitable**; **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ Whether its sample data and scenarios (including the August workflow and INR denomination) represent any real portfolio was not verified**; **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ Portfolio review involves potentially personal or client data**; **its data-protection arrangements were not assessed**; **⑩ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks, created 2026-09-06 and pushed 2026-09-07**, **attention is very low**, **so no maturity, correctness or adoption is claimed**; **⑪ ⭐ With a 1,289-byte README and no topics, its assessability is markedly lower than comparable projects** (**this is the entry’s own judgement**); **⑫ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**the README measurably is in English**). **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/Parv-005/actuary-os`, `/readme` and `/contents/` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 1,289-byte README and 568-byte `Makefile` read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim; the two large documents’ sizes come from the measured root listing, **their contents were not read**); **nothing cloned, installed, run or started, and no source or document body read**.
